NSPreferencePane.doc: The interface for providing preference panes to System Preferences or other apps.

NSPreferencePaneUnselectReply.doc: Constants that indicate the preference pane’s availability to be deselected.

NSUnselectLater.doc: Delay the deselection until the preference pane invokes replyToShouldUnselect:.

-assignMainView.doc: Locates and assigns the preference pane’s main view from the nib file loaded by loadMainView.

-didSelect.doc: Notifies the preference pane that the main app has just displayed the preference pane’s main view.

-didUnselect.doc: Notifies the preference pane that the main app has just stopped displaying the preference pane’s main view.

-initWithBundle:.doc: Initializes a preference pane with the specified bundle.

-loadMainView.doc: Loads the preference pane’s user interface into its main view.

-mainViewDidLoad.doc: Notifies the preference pane that the main view is set up and prepared to be displayed.

-replyToShouldUnselect:.doc: Notifies the main application of the preference pane’s ability to be deselected.

-willSelect.doc: Notifies the preference pane that the main app is about to display the preference pane’s main view.

-willUnselect.doc: Notifies the preference pane that the main app is about to stop displaying the preference pane’s main view.

autoSaveTextFields.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether text fields save their values before changing preference panes.

firstKeyView.doc: The first view in the keyboard focus chain.

initialKeyView.doc: The view that should have keyboard focus when the pane is selected.

lastKeyView.doc: The last view in the keyboard focus chain.

mainNibName.doc: The name of the preference pane’s nib file.

mainView.doc: The main view of the preference pane.

selected.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the preference pane is currently selected.

shouldUnselect.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the preference pane is able to be deselected.
